evidence.field: 形義通解; 《廣韻》 and Middle Chinese table
evidence.text: The entry explicitly analyzes 吧 as 从口、巴声. It lists two 《廣韻》 fanqie entries, 普巴 and 伯加, classified respectively 滂 and 幫 initials, with level tone, 麻 rhyme, open division II. 伯加 is a fanqie spelling, not a reading. The database lists particle functions including agreement, suggestion/imperative, conjecture/question and pause/condition, and separately quotes an onomatopoeic occurrence in 兒女英雄傳 chapter 15.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 字頭「吧」

evidence.field: 《說文》, 《廣韻》, 形義通解 for 巴
evidence.text: The entry transmits the received 說文 account 蟲也 and the alternative 或曰：食象蛇, labels several forms as oracle bone, small seal and other categories, and lists 巴’s 《廣韻》 伯加 entry as 幫 initial, level tone, 麻 rhyme, open division II. Later glosses include waiting/hope and approach, without demonstrating a semantic chain among them. The displayed form labels and received account do not by themselves settle the identification or continuous chronology of ancient 巴 forms.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 字頭「巴」

evidence.source: Fang, Hongmei & Kees Hengeveld, Sentence-final particles in Mandarin, LOT dissertation, chapter 3 (adapted from 2020 article)
evidence.field: PDF pp.35–61, especially p.36 and pp.52–61
evidence.text: The authors argue that Mandarin sentence-final ba has a unified mitigating function; interpretations such as suggestion or uncertainty arise through interaction with context. This is a functional analysis of the modern particle, not a history of the written graph.
evidence.title: Sentence-final particles in Mandarin

evidence.source: 江柏毅, CASE 報科學, National Taiwan University hosted article
evidence.text: The author reviews competing identifications of certain oracle-bone graphs formerly transcribed as 巴, including snake, composite snake/human, pregnant woman and human-form accounts, and argues for reading them as a seated person form instead. This is the article’s argued reinterpretation, not a settled identification; it concerns 巴’s own early graphic referent, not its later phonetic role in 吧.

gaps: The local 字源 corpus was searched and three relevant-looking locator pages were visually inspected. They are unrelated entries/quotation contexts and supply no character-specific claim for 吧. Consequently, the task’s requested article-linked 字源 evidence cannot be provided; record this as a source relevance gap rather than cite those pages.

The inspected 字源 pages were PDF p.432 (printed p.420), p.446 (printed p.434), and p.106 (printed p.94). Their cited corpus scan records have null printed_page metadata; printed page numbers above were read from the visible page images. No 吧-related OCR correction was found in these inspected occurrences. The corpus search did not establish an actual 吧 headword elsewhere.

No dated oracle-bone, bronze, seal or clerical attestation of the graph 吧 itself, no continuous graphic sequence, and no corruption account was verified. The particle’s reported historical examples date uses/spellings, not formation of the graph.
The 2022 survey’s dated particle spellings are secondary reports; no primary facsimile of 清语易言 or the cited earlier texts was inspected in this pass.

The particle’s lexical history remains contested or function-specific. The proposal from 罷/罢 and 夫/不乎 is not established by the inspected sources. The Venice-hosted paper proposes sentence-final 不是 > conjectural ba2 while separating imperative ba1 from it; this is the author’s hypothesis, not a settled universal account.
No early independent date for the onomatopoeic use was verified; CUHK quotes a Qing novel without a precise date and does not establish a historical link to the particle.
The English bar use is a whole-word lexical borrowing evidenced in 酒吧 by the Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary; the date and historically relevant source pronunciation were not established.
The precise semantic motivation for 口 in the particle graph is not explained by the inspected references.

The original referent/name of 巴 remains uncertain: received Shuowen and CUHK’s summary favor a snake explanation, while the CASE author argues that some oracle-bone forms assigned to 巴 should instead be read as a seated-person graph. This issue does not erase the independently supported phonetic-component claim in 吧.

Individual official Unicode Unihan records for U+5427 and U+5DF4 could not be opened. Local rows checked: U+53E3 kǒu, U+5427 ba, U+5DF4 bā. Do not use those local rows as external click-through evidence; upstream access failed.

Baxter–Sagart project table PDF for 巴 was surfaced in search but returned 502 on open; its result is only a locator lead. The directly opened reconstruction evidence available for 吧 is the secondary Zhengzhang table on Wiktionary, which lists 巴 *praː and 吧 *praː, *pʰraː.
Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese readings present in the dossier were not independently verified in this research pass.
